$comment: Single source of truth for the per-org home-screen icons. Read by scripts/fetch-brand-logos.mjs (downloads logoUrl → assets/brand-logos/<name>.png), scripts/generate-app-icons.mjs (renders the PNGs), app.config.ts (registers them with expo-alternate-app-icons) and src/lib/app-icon.ts (picks one for the active org). style: "brand" = each org's own logo on its colour; "ninja" = the white CMS NINJA wordmark on its colour (the previous look — set this to revert). After editing: node scripts/fetch-brand-logos.mjs (if logos changed) → node scripts/generate-app-icons.mjs → npx expo prebuild --clean → rebuild. Colours sampled from the web org picker 2026-10-02; logo URLs from the user (CMS Advice.logo).
